response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_line_product_cost, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0 THEN derived_total_cost / product_price END) as invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats), filtered_invoices AS (SELECT i.avg_line_product_cost, i.invoice_ratio FROM invoice_stats i WHERE i.invoice_ratio > (SELECT overall_avg_ratio FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(avg_line_product_cost), AVG(invoice_ratio), AVG(invoice_ratio) - (SELECT overall_avg_ratio FROM overall_avg) FROM filtered_invoices

assumptions.assumption: Lines where product_price is zero are excluded when computing each invoice's ratio average, because division by zero is undefined. The request mentions ignoring missing values but does not specify handling of zero prices.
